release_notes:
LockStepPDF 4.1.8

This hot-fix replaces the installed program file. The zip contains LockStepPDF.exe and the matching _internal folder. The updater copies that program onto the file name already installed, including ReadySetPDF.exe. It does not remove folders already next to the program, so the LibreOffice folder stays and Office files still convert. This zip does not include LibreOffice. Tesseract and Labels are inside the program folder.

Spreads: A new tool converts reader spreads and printer spreads, in both directions and down to single pages. It is visible only when the saved license key is RSP-TEST-PRO. A Pro key, the admin key, an enterprise key, a trial, and a computer with no key do not see the button, the help topic, or the step. A recipe that already contains Spread Convert skips that step and continues.

Tools: Notes in the tool panel wrap to the width of the panel.
